events.verdict: Allen (PHX) is not established in a defensive position in Morant's (MEM) path at the time of the contact, but the contact is marginal.
Williams (PHX) establishes a position in Wells' (MEM) path and as Wells navigates around the screen, the ensuing contact is marginal.

Wells (MEM) and Jackson Jr. (MEM) make contact with the ball, but do not get their hands so firmly on it to create a held ball situation. The ball contact causes Booker (PHX) to lose control of it, and he regains control after turning away from Wells. He takes one legal step, jumps and passes the ball.
Williams (PHX) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) and Aldama (MEM) make contact with the ball as Williams (PHX) tries to secure it, causing him to lose control.
Williams (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Jackson Jr. (MEM).
Gillespie (PHX) retreats away and the ensuing contact with Coward (MEM) off of the ball is marginal.
Booker (PHX) briefly clasps and releases Morant's (MEM) arm as they come together in the post.
Although Booker's (PHX) arms are not perfectly vertical, the contact with Morant's (MEM) arm during his shot attempt is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Booker's (PHX) arm.
